summary: The client did not send a single message this week. All 4 messages were ALTR-side, 3 of them on Aug 15 and none after Aug 17, so the chat has been dead for the last 4 days of the window and Chey has now been silent for 10 days (her last message was Aug 11). Stephski did honour her Aug 14 promise and sent the combined invoice on Aug 15 — Aug 1-14 plus the unpaid July 15-31 balance, the largest bill of the relationship — with updated Zelle details, which is a real attempt to fix the payment friction. But the extension she granted expired that same day and nothing was chased afterwards: no payment confirmation, no day-1 or day-3 follow-up across Aug 16-21. That is a direct regression from last week, where the day-1/day-3 chase cadence was the one thing this account got right. The July 15-31 invoice is now 20 days from send and 6 days past its extended deadline with no acknowledgement from the client at all. The Aug 15 invoice also carried a changed bank account number that the client has never acknowledged — an unconfirmed banking-detail change to a silent, cash-constrained client is a live risk. On delivery, Michelle's Aug 17 leak-removal breakdown was again the only visible output; the Promo topic has had nothing since Derrek's Aug 1 message and Social Media nothing since Jul 29, so Derrek's 'plenty of updates starting next week' promise is now 20 days overdue and in its third silent week. The account is going quiet in both directions.

health.rationale: Down from 55. Three things moved it: (1) the client went to zero messages for the first time since the chat opened and has now been silent 10 days, right after being told work could be paused for non-payment; (2) the extended payment deadline of Aug 15 lapsed with no payment, no acknowledgement and — unlike last week — no chase at all in the six days that followed, so the improved cadence did not hold; (3) the IG/promo side is now in its third consecutive week of zero output while the largest invoice to date sits unpaid.
